name: begin_parallel
semantics: Start a batch: following actor commands are queued on their actors' tracks and run concurrently instead of blocking one by one.

name: wait_for_actor
engine_fn: appends the actor object to the group list [0x03001004+4] (vt 0x0804DEEC, created on demand)
semantics: Restrict the next end_parallel to wait only for the listed actors' tracks (other tracks keep running in the background).

name: end_parallel
engine_fn: group list set: run_mode(group); else 0x0801934E: run_mode(wait-all 0x0804C0C4); director +0 = 0
semantics: Close the batch and block until all queued tracks (or only the wait_for_actor ones) are empty.

name: fire_wave_beam
semantics: Actor faces dir (sets actor+0x10), plays the firing animation (raw anim 0x12) and after 16 ticks spawns the wavy pink beam effect 0x080286D4 at actor + offset table 0x0877C430[dir]; done after `frames` more checks, then idle. Enqueues a command object on the actor's cutscene track (actor+0x18C list, director 0x03002BAC via 0x0801936A). Outside begin_parallel..end_parallel the native blocks (runs the wait mode 0x0804C0C4 through run_mode 0x0803D8A0) until every track is empty; inside a batch it returns immediately. If the actor id resolves to no object the command is destroyed without effect.
